---
title: "Minimal repro: visual mode drops table labels"
---

```{=html}
<!--
STEPS
  1. Open this file in VS Code.
  2. Switch to visual mode (Ctrl+Shift+F4).
  3. Type a character in the paragraph below, then delete it, so the document
     is marked dirty and gets written back.
  4. Save (Ctrl+S), switch back to source mode, and compare with git:
         git diff quarto_test/tbl-label-repro.qmd

EXPECTED
  The file is unchanged apart from your edit.

OBSERVED (on quarto.quarto 1.135.0)
  The table caption loses its label:
     -: A table caption {#tbl-nums}
     +: A table caption
  The figure keeps its {#fig-pic}. @tbl-nums then no longer resolves, and
  `quarto render` warns "Unable to resolve crossref @tbl-nums".

WHY
  pandoc's reader puts the label on the Table element itself --
      Table ( "tbl-nums" , [] , [] )
  -- and its markdown writer re-emits it correctly (verified with pandoc 3.9
  and Quarto's bundled 3.10, both round-trip this file losslessly).

  The visual editor's ProseMirror table node has no field for it. In
  assets/www/editor/index.js the spec reads

      attrs: { ...yb.table.attrs, width: {default:null}, colpercents: {default:null} }

  -- width and column percentages only, no identifier -- so the id has nowhere
  to live and is dropped on write-back.
-->
```

Edit this paragraph, then save. See @tbl-nums and @fig-pic.
